label: Booking / cancel / edit / wait-list flow
fix: Make booking state unambiguous (AM/PM or 24h, confirmed vs wait-list vs cancelled); fix edit/cancel paths; show the cut-off rule before the user commits.
metric: Booking completion rate; cancel-success rate; support tickets about booking per 1,000 trips
validate: Funnel analytics (open -> select -> confirm -> success); compare before/after in a staged rollout.
evidence_needed: Booking funnel drop-off and API failure logs; ticket categories.

label: App won't open / crashes / stuck / blank
fix: Triage Play Console / Crashlytics crashes by device, OS and version; check the 'cannot be used on a rooted device' block for false positives; fix the top crash clusters.
metric: Crash-free sessions (target >= 99.5%); ANR rate; app-open failure rate
validate: Play Vitals before/after each release; staged rollout.
evidence_needed: Crash clusters from Play Console; root-detection logs.

label: Login / session / sign-out
fix: Reduce forced re-authentication (longer session, silent token refresh); keep users logged in across app restarts; clearer errors for 'user not found'.
metric: Forced-logout rate per active user per week; login success rate
validate: Auth logs before/after; track login-related review share.
evidence_needed: Token expiry and refresh logs; SSO failure reasons; share of 'user not in system' (an employer-onboarding issue).

label: App slow / buggy / "not working" (unspecified)
fix: Add client performance telemetry (cold start, screen-load p95, API error rate by app version / OS / device); fix the top 3 slowest screens and top error codes first.
metric: p95 screen-load time; API error rate; share of sessions with an error
validate: Staged rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with before/after telemetry; track the 1-2 star share of reviews mentioning slow/bugs.
evidence_needed: Play Console vitals + client telemetry by device/OS/version; backend latency logs.

label: OTP not received / not working
fix: Add SMS auto-read (SMS Retriever), resend with cooldown, and a voice or in-app fallback; monitor delivery by operator.
metric: OTP delivery success rate; median time-to-verify; OTP resend rate
validate: Vendor delivery reports by operator; before/after in staged rollout.
evidence_needed: OTP send/deliver/verify logs and the SMS vendor's delivery reports.

label: Live tracking / GPS / ETA wrong
fix: Show 'last updated' time on the cab marker; fall back to schedule-based ETA when GPS is stale; audit the vendor GPS ping interval.
metric: GPS staleness (median / p95 age of last ping); ETA error in minutes
validate: Compare predicted vs actual arrival for a sample of trips; track tracking-related review share.
evidence_needed: GPS ping logs per vehicle/vendor; ETA predicted vs actual.

label: Notifications / reminders / pop-ups
fix: Audit notification triggers (remove test messages, fix wrong-time messages); give users control of reminders.
metric: Notification delivery rate; share of notifications sent at the wrong time
validate: Push delivery logs vs trip events.

label: Cannot call / contact the driver
fix: Make in-app calling reliable (masked numbers with a fallback number); show the driver's number and cab details clearly.
metric: Call connect rate; calls per trip that fail
evidence_needed: Call logs by vendor and error type; check if employer policy disables calling.

label: Forced / blocked trip rating or survey
fix: Make the post-trip rating and feedback screen skippable and non-blocking.
metric: Rating prompt skip rate; reviews mentioning forced rating
evidence_needed: None needed; it is a product decision.

label: Confusing UI / redesign / usability
fix: Bring back the information users say disappeared (pickup time, co-passengers); test any redesign with a small user group before release.
metric: Task success in usability tests; UI-related review share
validate: 5-8 user tests with employees; compare review share after release.
evidence_needed: Screen analytics and session recordings; usability tests.

label: Check-in / QR scan / face-mask / vehicle verification
fix: Fix QR/check-in failures and the 'face mask' / vehicle-verification steps; allow a safe manual fallback.
metric: Check-in success rate; share of trips marked no-show after a failed check-in

label: Helpdesk / support / no response
fix: Show a working helpdesk/transport-desk contact and a ticket status inside the app; set a response-time target.
metric: First-response time; ticket resolution time; tickets raised in-app
evidence_needed: Ticket volumes, response times, who handles escalations.

label: Safety / SOS / emergency
fix: Make the SOS button reachable without re-login and without hunting through menus.
metric: Time to trigger SOS; SOS success rate

label: Cab late / not assigned / route problems
fix: Operations programme: vendor on-time dashboards, route-clubbing review, late-pickup escalation. Mostly not an app fix.
metric: On-time pickup rate; late-cab complaints per 1,000 trips
evidence_needed: Trip logs with scheduled vs actual pickup times by vendor.

label: Employer rules - cancel cut-off / no-show penalty / booking window
fix: Show the employer's cancel/no-show rule in the app before booking and when cancelling; give customer-success a way to review the rule settings per employer.
metric: No-show disputes; cancellation-rule complaints per 1,000 trips
evidence_needed: Per-employer rule configuration vs complaint volume.

label: Driver rude / refuses / unsafe driving
fix: Vendor scorecards and driver conduct escalation. Not an app fix.
